reason: The first task is free and the spend is capped, so I'd try one small copy task to see if the judge's scores make sense. I wouldn't pay for a second one until I've seen what comes back.
objection: I'd have to write or approve a rubric for every task, and I'm not sure an AI judge scoring sealed entries picks the copy I'd actually pick. It's also one person, unaudited, paid in USDC on Solana, and I have no reviews from other buyers.
would_change_my_mind: Reviews or case studies from other founders showing the winning entries were good, and a way to pay by card instead of USDC.
